headline: True-positive cloud-to-mailbox attack with confirmed data access from 185.220.101.42
summary: Between 2026-07-17 22:53:46 and 2026-07-17 22:53:48, a confirmed malicious attack from 185.220.101.42 progressed through credential access, discovery, initial access, lateral movement, and collection. Evidence shows managed identity token theft from webapp-vm-001, ARM enumeration, device-code sign-in to graph-mail-reader-app-id, retrieval of Key Vault secret graph-sp-secret, storage account key retrieval for PRODDATA001, and mailbox access to cfo@contoso.com. Sensitive data access/exfiltration is confirmed in the report.
